title: Till There Was You, after Rod Stewart

details.title: Till There Was You
details.lead: Rod Stewart's sung line, played straight on the trumpet, an octave above where he sings it, in his key: concert D4 to G♭5 (written E4 to A♭5).
facts: Till There Was You, as Rod Stewart sings it on the recording you sent
Rod's voice, read note by note and straightened
E concert, F♯ for the trumpet
The song as Rod sings it, with rests where the band plays alone
